facts.fact: Chathu, first witness at every one of the forty's turnings, will cage from the wall any of the forty who refuses to hunt Neela and Devan after the forced turning.
Chathu's hunters hold the wood road behind Neela's party, so there is no riding home before dawn.
Corrects F606: Bhaskaran, eight spearmen, Devan and Neela ride in (eleven); five Kettamala men and Pavi are outside the wall, since Vasu rode to Kettamala.
Madhavi is one of the forty (replaces a name that echoed a village).
